friendly_name: Atomic Capture Finalize Across Route Kinds
purpose_context: The inbox capture agent can currently mark a note processed without having routed its content on non-calendar routes, silently losing Kent's captured intentions. #737 fixed this for calendar only. This mission generalizes the atomic finalize to all route kinds (someday, journal, vikunja_task including the tasker-delegated path, github_issue, and calendar folded in), removes the agent's standalone mark_processed, and adds a health rail for notes marked processed with no routing-log entry.
purpose_tldr: Make inbox capture route-and-finalize atomic for every route kind so a note can never be marked processed without a verified route.
